title: DeckyHub Installer
privacy: Your privacy: nothing about you or your Deck is collected, saved or sent anywhere. Your password is used only on this Deck, right now, and is never stored. The installer only downloads files from GitHub.
otherWay: You can also install DeckyHub without this installer: download its ZIP and add it in Decky's settings (no password needed). Steps: {url}
responsibility: These plugins are made by other people. DeckyHub doesn't make, review or vouch for them, and it isn't responsible for anything they do to your Deck or your data. You install them at your own risk. Before you do, read each plugin's notes and look at its page on deckyhub.com (details and security scans) and at its author's GitHub page (both are linked on each plugin's card).
warranty: DeckyHub is a free community project. It comes as it is, with no guarantee.
picker.deckyNewest: the newest release, chosen by Decky's own installer
picker.heading: Optional plugins
picker.eitherWay: Decky Loader and DeckyHub are installed either way.
picker.next: Next you'll see {total} optional plugins, one at a time. Choose Add or Skip for each, or skip this: you can always add plugins later from DeckyHub.
picker.notInstalledHere: This installer doesn't install them. DeckyHub asks you to confirm each one the first time you open it.
card.lookFirst: Look at it before you decide:
card.risk: You install it at your own risk: DeckyHub isn't responsible for what it does. A clean audit isn't proof of safety. Nothing is added unless you choose Add.
intro.stepPassword: You type your Deck's admin password.
intro.stepDeckyChecked: Decky Loader comes first. It's the add-on system DeckyHub runs in. We only check that it's installed. It is, so nothing is installed or changed here.
intro.stepDeckyInstall: Decky Loader comes first. It's the add-on system DeckyHub runs in, and it isn't installed yet, so it's installed now.
intro.stepDownload: Only then is DeckyHub {tag} downloaded from GitHub and checked, to make sure it's the right file.
intro.stepPut: DeckyHub is put in its folder. If you already have it, your old copy stays safe until the new one is ready.
intro.stepRestart: Decky Loader restarts. This takes a few seconds.
intro.whyRestart: Why a password? Restarting Decky Loader is a change to the Deck itself, and the Deck only allows that with the admin password.
intro.whyInstall: Why a password? Installing and restarting Decky Loader are changes to the Deck itself, and the Deck only allows that with the admin password. Decky Loader's own installer asks for the same one.
intro.headlineInstall: This will download and install DeckyHub {tag} on your Steam Deck.
intro.headlineUpdate: This will download and update DeckyHub {tag} on your Steam Deck.
intro.headlineReinstall: This will download and reinstall DeckyHub {tag} on your Steam Deck.
intro.deckyOnlyChecked: Decky Loader is already installed, so it's only checked.
intro.headlineBoth: This will download and install Decky Loader and DeckyHub {tag} on your Steam Deck.
intro.extras: Next you can pick optional plugins, such as frame generation or themes. They aren't installed now: DeckyHub asks you to confirm each one later.

error.noGithub:
Can't reach GitHub.

Check that your Deck is connected to Wi-Fi, then start the installer again.
password.tempQuestion:
Your Deck doesn't have an admin password yet.

The installer can set a temporary one ({password}), use it, and remove it again when it's done. Decky Loader's own installer does the same.

If the installer is ever cut off, the password stays until you remove it: open Konsole and type  {command}  with this password.

Continue?
password.setFailed:
Couldn't set a temporary password.

Open Konsole, type passwd and press Enter to set your own, then start the installer again.
password.needed:
An admin password is needed.

Open Konsole, type passwd and press Enter to set one, then start the installer again.
password.prompt:
Type your Deck's admin password.

This is the password you set for Desktop Mode, not your Steam password. It's used only on this Deck, right now, and isn't saved.
password.wrong: That password isn't right. Try again.
progress.installingDecky: Installing Decky Loader first (about a minute)…
progress.checkingDecky: Checking that Decky Loader is installed…
error.deckyDownload:
Couldn't download Decky Loader.

Check your Wi-Fi and try again. If it keeps failing, install Decky Loader from {url} first, then start this installer again.
error.deckyUnfinished:
Decky Loader didn't finish installing.

Install it from {url} first, then start this installer again.
error.checksum:
The downloaded file isn't the right one (its checksum doesn't match), so nothing was installed.

This is usually a Wi-Fi hiccup. Start the installer again. If it keeps happening, download DeckyHub yourself from {url} and install it by hand.
error.damaged:
The downloaded file is damaged.

Start the installer again.
error.prepare:
Couldn't prepare the folder for DeckyHub.

Make sure your Deck has free space, then try again.
error.copy:
Couldn't copy DeckyHub's files.

Make sure your Deck has free space, then try again.
error.replace:
Couldn't replace your current DeckyHub.

Close anything that might be using it, then try again.
error.restore:
The update failed, and your old DeckyHub couldn't be put back automatically.
It's saved here: {path}
error.place:
Couldn't put DeckyHub's files in place.

Make sure your Deck has free space, then try again.
error.unexpected:
The installer stopped unexpectedly.

Make sure your Deck has free space and Wi-Fi, then try again.
done.title: All done!
done.noRestart: Decky Loader couldn't restart by itself. Restart your Steam Deck to start using DeckyHub.
done.picked: {count} optional plugin(s) chosen. DeckyHub asks you to confirm them when you open it.
done.cleanup: The installer's temporary files are removed when you close this.
done.cleanupPassword: The installer's temporary files and the temporary password are removed when you close this.
done.next: What now: switch to Gaming Mode, open the Quick Access menu (the ··· button) and choose DeckyHub.
done.nothingSent: Nothing about you or your Deck was collected or sent.
